en.name: The Third Act
en.flavor: The theatre is eerily silent. The old wooden floor creaks beneath your feet, and a light rain gently patters on the roof as you explore the auditorium. There are more rotting corpses among the seats, and the rest of the crowd has vanished…
en.back_text: Search all set-aside cards and the victory display for the Royal Emissary enemy, and spawn it in the Theatre.
en.back_flavor: Abruptly, the malformed body of an unnatural nightmare slams onto the stage, its slithering tendrils reaching into the aisles. It opens its maw and lets out a shrill, piercing song. The melody is uncanny; the notes sear into your mind. Pain pounds in your forehead, and blood runs from your ears.

vi_current.name: Màn Ba
vi_current.flavor: Vở kịch Vua Áo Vàng vừa hạ màn, nhưng sự kinh hoàng dường như chỉ mới bắt đầu. Khán giả xung quanh bạn bất động như những bức tượng vô hồn, ánh mắt trống rỗng nhìn chằm chằm lên sân khấu.
vi_current.back_text:
Spawn kẻ địch The Man in the Pallid Mask đang để riêng tại Theatre. Nếu The Man in the Pallid Mask không thể spawn, spawn 1 kẻ địch [[Poltergeist]] tại Theatre thay thế.
Mỗi điều tra viên chịu 1 horror.
vi_current.back_flavor: Một tràng pháo tay giòn giã vang lên từ hàng ghế sau lưng bạn, nhưng khi ngoảnh lại, bạn chỉ thấy những thi thể tái nhợt và một bóng người bí ẩn mang mặt nạ đang lặng lẽ rảo bước về phía lối thoát.

en.name: Encore
en.text: Forced - After Royal Emissary is added to the victory display: Remove all doom from play and reset the agenda deck to agenda 1a. Then, place 3 doom on that agenda.
en.flavor: The creature’s song echoes relentlessly throughout the halls of the theatre. The melody repeats again and again, yet somehow, never the same note twice.
en.back_text: Each investigator takes 100 horror (cannot be prevented).
en.back_flavor: The song grows louder and louder, until it drowns out all of your thoughts. You collapse to the floor and cover your ears, but try as you might, you cannot muffle the intensity of the creature's awful voice. The whole world threatens to close around you, until at last you hear a discordant phrase throughout the melody: "EXIT NOW."

vi_current.name: Hạ Màn
vi_current.text: Forced - Sau khi Royal Emissary được thêm vào khu vực trưng bày thành tích: Xóa tất cả doom khỏi trò chơi và đặt lại bộ agenda về agenda 1a. Sau đó, đặt 3 doom lên agenda đó.
vi_current.flavor: Ngọn lửa bốc lên từ sân khấu, lan nhanh qua các tấm rèm nhung đỏ. Mùi khói khét lẹt quyện với mùi lưu huỳnh và tử khí nồng nặc.
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên chưa resign bị đánh bại và chịu 1 physical trauma. (→R2)
vi_current.back_flavor: Mái vòm của nhà hát Ward sụp đổ trong ngọn lửa rực trời. Bạn bị chôn vùi dưới đống xà gồ bốc cháy khi thế giới xung quanh biến thành biển lửa Carcosa.

en.name: Awakening
en.flavor: You pinch yourself to see if you are dreaming, and sure enough, your skin stings and reddens. You take a few deep breaths and try to think rationally. Whatever is going on, you must explore the theatre to learn the truth of the matter.
en.back_text: Choose one of the set-aside locations, at random. Put that location into play, and spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at that location (instead of his normal spawn location). Advance to one of the 3 copies of act 2a, at random. Remove the other 2 copies of act 2a from the game without looking at them.
en.back_flavor:
A shadow creeps along the wall beside you, and your heart leaps into your throat. You turn, and a figure flits away just out of sight. Either your mind is playing tricks on you, or someone else is in the theatre.
You follow the direction of the shadow, rounding a nearby corner. At the far end of the hall, he stands awaiting you: a man in an elegant black suit, his face covered by a pale mask. Though his attire has changed, you instantly recognize him as the actor who played the role of the Stranger - one of the characters from <u>The King in Yellow</u>. He turns and disappears through an open doorway, as if taunting you to follow.

vi_current.name: Thức Tỉnh
vi_current.text: Objective — Chỉ các điều tra viên tại Theatre mới có thể cùng nhau chi trả số lượng manh mối cần thiết để advance.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn bàng hoàng tỉnh giấc sau một cơn mê man kỳ lạ. Khán phòng nhà hát vắng lặng đến rợn người, chỉ còn vương lại những vệt máu tươi và sự hỗn loạn khó hiểu.
vi_current.back_text:
Đặt các địa điểm Lobby, Balcony, và Backstage đang để riêng vào màn chơi. Tiết lộ Lobby.
Spawn kẻ địch Royal Emissary đang để riêng tại Theatre.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn bước ra khỏi khán phòng và nhận ra toàn bộ nhà hát đã bị khóa kín. Nhưng nguy hiểm hơn cả, một sinh vật dị hợm khoác long bào rách rưới đang lướt đi giữa các hàng ghế, săn lùng những kẻ còn sống sót.

en.name: The Stranger
en.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
en.flavor: The mysterious Stranger from <u>The King in Yellow</u> might know something about what happened during the intermission. You must find and confront him if you are to discover the truth.
en.back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [cultist] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on the Theatre. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents spreading flames, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you enter this location or end your turn at this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
en.back_flavor: As you face off with the Stranger, you get the sense that he is grinning beneath his pale, faceless mask. "Where is everyone?" you ask, but he does not respond. "What is going on?" He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. You feel intense heat behind you, and you turn to see flames roaring throughout the auditorium. You turn back to the Stranger, but he is gone.

vi_current.name: Kẻ Xa Lạ
vi_current.text: Objective — Nếu The Man in the Pallid Mask bị đánh bại, advance.
vi_current.flavor: Người đàn ông mang mặt nạ tái nhợt dường như nắm giữ chìa khóa thoát khỏi nhà hát này. Bạn phải đuổi kịp và khống chế hắn!
vi_current.back_text:
Mỗi điều tra viên tại cùng địa điểm với The Man in the Pallid Mask nhận 1 manh mối từ kho token.
Advance sang Act 3 — "Curtain Call".
vi_current.back_flavor: Khi bị dồn vào chân tường, gã mang mặt nạ buông rơi chùm chìa khóa thoát hiểm rồi tan biến vào màn sương mờ ảo tựa một bóng ma.

en.name: The Stranger
en.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
en.flavor: The mysterious Stranger from <u>The King in Yellow</u> might know something about what happened during the intermission. You must find and confront him if you are to discover the truth.
en.back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [tablet] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on the location The Man in the Pallid Mask was moved from. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents the advancing ooze, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you leave this location: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 horror and 1 damage." Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
en.back_flavor: As you face off with the Stranger, you get the sense that he is grinning beneath his pale, faceless mask. "Where is everyone?" you ask, but he does not respond. "What is going on?" He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. Inexplicably, he continues to back away, and his body melds into the wall behind him. Erupting from where he stood is a growing mass of viscous ooze.

vi_current.name: Kẻ Xa Lạ
vi_current.text: Objective — Nếu The Man in the Pallid Mask bị đánh bại, advance.
vi_current.flavor: Người đàn ông mang mặt nạ tái nhợt lướt đi thoăn thoắt qua các hành lang ngập khói. Bạn phải chặn đứng hắn!
vi_current.back_text:
Mỗi điều tra viên tại cùng địa điểm với The Man in the Pallid Mask nhận 1 manh mối từ kho token.
Advance sang Act 3 — "Curtain Call".
vi_current.back_flavor: Khi bị dồn vào chân tường, gã mang mặt nạ buông rơi chùm chìa khóa thoát hiểm rồi tan biến vào màn sương mờ ảo tựa một bóng ma.

en.flavor: The mysterious Stranger from <u>The King in Yellow</u> might know something about what happened during the intermission. You must find and confront him if you are to discover the truth.
en.back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [elder_thing] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on each [[Private]] location. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents flooding water, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - When you would leave this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage and cancel the effects of the move. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
en.back_flavor: As you face off with the Stranger, you get the sense that he is grinning beneath his pale, faceless mask. "Where is everyone?" you ask, but he does not respond. "What is going on?" He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. You spin in shock as the windows shatter, and a deluge of cold salt water floods the room. You turn back to the Stranger, but he is gone.

vi_current.name: Kẻ Xa Lạ
vi_current.text: Objective — Nếu The Man in the Pallid Mask bị đánh bại, advance.
vi_current.flavor: Gã mang mặt nạ đứng sừng sững cuối hành lang, dõi theo bạn bằng ánh nhìn lạnh ngắt qua hai hốc mắt trống rỗng.
vi_current.back_text:
Mỗi điều tra viên tại cùng địa điểm với The Man in the Pallid Mask nhận 1 manh mối từ kho token.
Advance sang Act 3 — "Curtain Call".
vi_current.back_flavor: Khi bị dồn vào chân tường, gã mang mặt nạ buông rơi chùm chìa khóa thoát hiểm rồi tan biến vào màn sương mờ ảo tựa một bóng ma.

en.name: Curtain Call
en.text: While The Man in the Pallid Mask is not in play, the Lobby gains: "[action]: Resign." Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 horror on each location with no horror that is connected to a location with horror. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
en.flavor: The Stranger must know the way out. You have to follow him!
en.back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - We have to warn the police about what's going on! (→R1) - The police won't believe us. We have to solve this mystery on our own. (→R2)
en.back_flavor:
The Stranger gives you a slight bow as he steps through the lobby's front entrance, opening a glass door that was not there a moment before. A sudden cacophony of noise erupts around you, and you fear that the building has only seconds before it is destroyed. You flee, crashing through the front doors and leaving the ruined theatre in your wake. 
Several blocks away, you take a moment to rest and think about what you've witnessed...

vi_current.name: Hạ Màn
vi_current.text: Objective — Nếu mỗi điều tra viên chưa bị đánh bại đã resign, advance. [action]: Resign. Bạn mở tung cửa thoát hiểm và lao ra màn đêm Arkham.
vi_current.flavor: Lửa đã bén tới trần nhà và quái vật đang lùng sục khắp nơi. Lối thoát hiểm duy nhất nằm ở sảnh chính!
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn lao qua cánh cửa thoát hiểm, ngã nhào xuống vỉa hè lạnh buốt của Arkham khi nhà hát Ward chìm trong biển lửa phía sau lưng.

en.name: Fashionably Late
en.flavor: As you pull up to the manor, you notice that something is wrong. A trail of blood leads up the porch steps, and the front door is smashed. Muted music comes from within the house, its warped and discordant notes painful to your ears. Has the madness of <u>The King in Yellow</u> already made its way here?
en.back_text:
Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it. Spawn the set-aside Dianne Devine enemy at that asset's location.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
en.back_flavor: "Ah, if it isn't our final guest," the doorman announces. "Miss Devine, your presence here has been long awaited." The woman wears a devilish dress and similar grin. You swear you've seen the symbol on her amulet before. "Well, now the <u>real</u> party can begin," she declares, then heads off to mingle with the other party-goers.

vi_current.name: Đến Muộn Theo Phong Cách
vi_current.flavor: Bữa tiệc tối tại dinh thự của Constance Dumaine đang diễn ra vô cùng náo nhiệt. Những vị khách quyền quý uống sâm panh và bàn tán say sưa về buổi công diễn vở kịch.
vi_current.back_text:
Đặt 1 doom lên mỗi khách mời (Bystander) đang trong màn chơi.
Tiến hành lật mặt các khách mời sang dạng Lunatic nếu họ tích lũy đủ số token.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những nụ cười trên gương mặt các vị khách bỗng trở nên méo mó dị thường. Ánh mắt họ vằn lên những tia máu điên loạn.

en.name: The Terrifying Truth
en.text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and randomly resolve one of the Sickening Reality cards underneath the scenario reference card. If there are no cards underneath the scenario reference card, advance to agenda 2b instead.
en.flavor: More and more, this place continues to fall into madness, transforming before your very eyes…
en.back_flavor: It's all in your head. It must be. How else could you explain what is going on around you? You've had one too many drinks, and your mind is playing tricks on you. Everybody is having so much fun - all they want is for you to join them.

vi_current.name: Sự Thật Kinh Hoàng
vi_current.text: Forced - Khi agenda này sẽ advance bằng cách đạt đến ngưỡng doom: Thay vào đó, hãy xóa tất cả doom trong màn chơi và giải quyết ngẫu nhiên một trong các thẻ Thực tế Bệnh hoạn bên dưới thẻ tham chiếu màn chơi. Nếu không có thẻ nào bên dưới thẻ tham chiếu màn chơi, thay vào đó hãy chuyển sang advance vào agenda 2b.
vi_current.flavor: Bữa tiệc sang trọng biến thành một cơn ác mộng đẫm máu. Những vị khách tao nhã giờ đây đã hóa thành những kẻ điên loạn khát máu!
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên chưa resign bị đánh bại. (→R2)
vi_current.back_flavor: Những kẻ điên loạn bao vây lấy bạn trong tiếng cười man dại. Dinh thự Dumaine trở thành lò sát sinh dưới ánh trăng máu.

en.name: Discovering the Truth
en.text: Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this act, instead of placing them at his or her location. Objective - Find as many clues as you can, then get out of this awful place!
en.flavor: This isn’t a party: it’s a mad house. But for some reason, the guests are too deluded to notice. Very few of them are sane, and many are themselves horrors to your eye. Perhaps you can talk to them to learn more about <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
en.back_text: Madness. noun. mad.ness. The state of being mentally ill, especially severely. - Extremely foolish behavior. - A state of frenzied or chaotic activity. - Why are you looking at this side? - There is no reason to flip to Act 1b. - Flip back to Act 1a.

vi_current.name: Khám Phá Sự Thật
vi_current.text: Objective — Thẩm vấn càng nhiều khách mời càng tốt trước khi cơn điên loạn bùng nổ. [action]: Resign. Bạn rời khỏi bữa tiệc trước khi quá muộn.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn phải trò chuyện và dò hỏi năm vị khách mời danh giá để tìm hiểu chân tướng về vở kịch Vua Áo Vàng.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn thoát ra cổng dinh thự với những mảnh ghi chép nhuốm màu điên loạn, để lại sau lưng những tiếng gầm gừ ghê rợn.

en.name: The Truth is Hidden
en.text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.
en.flavor: Surprisingly, the front doors of the Historical Society’s Georgian manor are cracked halfway open when you arrive. Who else could be here at this hour?
en.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
en.back_flavor:
A phrase in a language you cannot describe whispers through the building, and without warning all of the electric lights shatter at once. You light a nearby candle and continue your search.
The building is quite different once plunged into darkness. Shadows and silhouettes dance along the walls. Crevices you hadn't noticed before draw your wary eye. What other secrets does this building hold?

vi_current.name: Sự Thật Bị Che Giấu
vi_current.text: Bỏ qua bước 'Đặt doom số 1 trong agenda hiện tại' của giai đoạn Mythos. Forced - Sau khi 1 hoặc nhiều manh mối được đặt trên kẻ địch trong màn chơi: Lật các manh mối đó sang phía doom của chúng.
vi_current.flavor: Tòa nhà của Hội Lịch sử Arkham chứa đầy những cổ vật và tài liệu bí mật. Bạn phải tìm ra mối liên hệ giữa dòng họ Peabody và vở kịch Vua Áo Vàng.
vi_current.back_text: Spawn kẻ địch Seeker of Carcosa tại Ground Floor. Đặt 1 doom lên Seeker of Carcosa.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những tiếng bước chân lạo xạo vang lên trên sàn gỗ. Những kẻ sùng bái Carcosa đã đột nhập vào tòa nhà trước bạn!

en.name: Ransacking the Manor
en.text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.
en.flavor: Though the whispering has ceased, the sounds of rummaging and furniture shifting is unmistakable. Whoever is here, they’re searching just as thoroughly as you are...
en.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Possessed Oathspeaker enemy at the Entry Hall. Check Campaign Log. If Sebastien Moreau is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Sebastien Moreau (Savage Hysteria) and spawn him in the Entry Hall.
en.back_flavor:
The front door of the manor opens, letting in a howl of chill wind and the pitter-patter of soft rain, then it suddenly slams shut. You find a place to hide and eavesdrop, wondering who else might have entered the building this late. "No, I swear, I swear I don't know where the door is!" A man cries out. "You'll have to find the Path on your own, I cannot help you!" He sounds panicked and disorientated.
"You spoke the Oath," a man's voice responds. "You spoke His name." The man stammers. "No! No, I cannot! I will not!" Then, his voice becomes distorted, and he speaks no more. You hear footsteps on the staircase - heavy and wet.

vi_current.name: Lục Soát Dinh Thự
vi_current.text: Bỏ qua bước 'Đặt doom số 1 trong agenda hiện tại' của giai đoạn Mythos. Forced - Sau khi 1 hoặc nhiều manh mối được đặt trên kẻ địch trong màn chơi: Lật các manh mối đó sang phía doom của chúng.
vi_current.flavor: Lũ tà giáo đang điên cuồng lục tung các ngăn tủ và phá hủy các tài liệu lịch sử quý giá.
vi_current.back_text: Đặt 1 doom lên agenda này cho mỗi kẻ địch [[Cultist]] đang trong màn chơi.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những trang giấy cổ bị xé vụn và đốt cháy trong lò sưởi, mang theo những bí mật lịch sử vĩnh viễn biến mất.

en.name: Secrets Better Left Hidden
en.text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.
en.flavor: Whoever these people are, they must be involved with the conspiracy behind The King in Yellow. You can’t let them find whatever it is they’re looking for!
en.back_flavor: There is a rush of footsteps along the manor's central stairway, and the front door opens once more. "Have you found it?" A muffled voice asks. "Yes. We can embark immediately. The Path will be opened." The door closes, and the manor returns to being quiet and lonely. For the remainder of your search, you find no further traces of the mysterious robed figures, nor do you find any information to answer your many questions about The King in Yellow...

vi_current.name: Những Bí Mật Tốt Nhất Nên Chôn Giấu
vi_current.text: Bỏ qua bước 'Đặt doom số 1 trong agenda hiện tại' của giai đoạn Mythos. Forced - Sau khi 1 hoặc nhiều manh mối được đặt trên kẻ địch trong màn chơi: Lật các manh mối đó sang phía doom của chúng.
vi_current.flavor: Thời gian không còn nhiều. Lũ tà giáo sắp tìm thấy cổ vật mà chúng khao khát!
vi_current.back_name: Cổ Vật Rơi Vào Tay Kẻ Ác
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên chịu 2 horror. (→R3)
vi_current.back_flavor: Lũ giáo đồ Carcosa tìm thấy chiếc móc khóa cổ xưa mang Dấu Hiệu Vàng và tẩu thoát vào màn đêm.

en.name: Race for Answers
en.flavor: Each of the Historical Society’s many rooms contains records and documents that may aid you in your search for answers about The King in Yellow. There must be something here that can guide you toward the truth.
en.back_text: For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
en.back_flavor: You find a record kept by one of the society's historians pertaining to the "dreadful events" surrounding the closing of an old theatre in Arkham, the Cedar Playhouse. Though there is no explicit mention of The King in Yellow, you believe you are on the right track. The historian's notes are cut short, and there is a faded, handwritten page clipped to the final entry. This matter is too ghastly for the public eye. I am placing the remainder of this record in the hidden library. All further inquiries should be done away from prying eyes, for this is a dangerous matter, and not one to be researched lightly.

vi_current.name: Chạy Đua Tìm Lời Giải
vi_current.text: Objective — Chỉ các điều tra viên tại Third Floor mới có thể cùng nhau chi trả số lượng manh mối cần thiết để advance.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn phải lên tầng ba của tòa nhà, nơi cất giữ những bộ sưu tập tài liệu quý hiếm nhất của hội.
vi_current.back_text: Đặt địa điểm Hidden Library vào màn chơi. Tiết lộ Hidden Library.
vi_current.back_flavor: Một giá sách bí mật dịch chuyển sang bên, để lộ lối vào một căn phòng ẩn được niêm phong suốt hàng thập kỷ.

en.name: Mistakes of the Past
en.flavor: Somewhere in the manor is a "hidden library" where you might be able to find more information about The King in Yellow. You must find the way in if you are to continue your investigation.
en.back_text:
For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Mr. Peabody asset.
Put the set-aside Hidden Library location into play.
en.back_flavor:
As you rummage through a desk drawer, you are startled when you hear a voice behind you. "Excuse me! Can I help you?" You are relived to find the voice belonging to a thin, elderly man wearing wide-rimmed glasses - a member of the Historical Society, no doubt. You explain to him that you are searching for a hidden library somewhere in the manor, though you purposely leave out why.
He introduces himself as Mr. Peabody, the Historical Society's curator. "I'll help you find what you are looking for," he explains, "but only if you tell me what this is all about once we get there." You hope it doesn't come to that.

vi_current.name: Sai Lầm Quá Khứ
vi_current.text: Objective — Chỉ các điều tra viên tại Hidden Library mới có thể cùng nhau chi trả số lượng manh mối cần thiết để advance.
vi_current.flavor: Bên trong thư viện bí mật, những ghi chép cổ xưa hé lộ nguồn gốc đen tối của chiếc kẹp áo mang Dấu Hiệu Vàng.
vi_current.back_name: Móc Cài Của Những Ngôi Sao Đen
vi_current.back_text: Đặt Clasp of Black Stars vào màn chơi dưới quyền kiểm soát của điều tra viên chính.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tìm thấy chiếc kẹp áo bằng đá đen lấp lánh ánh kim kỳ dị. Một luồng hàn khí chạy dọc sống lưng khi ngón tay bạn chạm vào cổ vật.

en.name: The Oath
en.text: Locations with the [[Passageway]] trait are connected to one another. Objective - Only investigators in the Hidden Library may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: "This building is very old, and filled with all manner of secret passageways," Mr. Peabody explains. "Perhaps one of them will lead to this library you’re looking for."
en.back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - This is an important discovery! We should take it with us. (→R1). - It's just a silly trinket, and it would be wrong to steal from the Historical Society. Leave it behind. (→R2)
en.back_flavor: As you study the hidden library, you find a few pieces of information that stand out. As with the recent production, the previous performance of The King in Yellow came to Arkham from overseas, and was performed by a French acting troupe. You don't recognize any of the cast members' names, and of course the actor who played the role of the Stranger is anonymous. However, it seems that a member of the Historical Society has done some of your work for you; there are several old newspaper clippings gathered together along with information about the play. Headlines include: Cedar Playhouse Closes Due To Fire, Experts Baffled Over Freak Floods, and the like. Hidden amongst this information, you also find a strange object - A clasp of onyx with an alien inscription.

vi_current.name: Lời Thề
vi_current.text: Objective — Nếu mỗi điều tra viên chưa bị đánh bại đã resign, advance. [action]: Resign. Bạn thoát khỏi tòa nhà cùng với cổ vật.
vi_current.flavor: Với cổ vật trong tay, bạn phải nhanh chóng rời khỏi Hội Lịch sử Arkham trước khi bị lũ tà giáo bao vây tiêu diệt.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn lao ra ngoài trời mưa gió, mang theo chiếc móc cài cổ xưa và lời thề sẽ làm sáng tỏ bí ẩn đến cùng.

en.name: Locked Inside
en.flavor: The patient wing of the asylum is far quieter and lonelier than you had expected. The hall reeks of chemicals and body odor. As soon as you are escorted inside, the doors behind you are closed and locked tight.
en.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each of the set-aside [[Possessed]] enemies into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it.
en.back_flavor: Speaking with the patients is proving more difficult than you had assumed. They eye you cautiously and refuse to answer any of your questions, backing away or fleeing if confronted. Either they're not used to guests, or something about you is causing them a considerable amount of distress. Some act like animals back into a corner, and you think at any moment they might strike.

vi_current.name: Bị Khóa Bên Trong
vi_current.flavor: Để tìm gặp Daniel Chesterfield, bạn đã đóng giả làm bệnh nhân để đột nhập vào Viện Tâm thần Arkham. Nhưng giờ đây, những cánh cửa sắt kiên cố đã bị khóa chặt sau lưng bạn.
vi_current.back_text: Spawn kẻ địch Asylum Gorger tại Asylum Halls. Mỗi điều tra viên chịu 1 horror.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những tiếng gào thét man dại dội lại từ các phòng biệt giam. Lũ bảo vệ biến chất và những quái vật kinh hoàng bắt đầu tuần tra các hành lang.

en.name: Torturous Descent
en.flavor: The longer you spend in this hellish place, the more you want to leave. Already it has felt like days. You fear that if you are stuck here much longer, you will become like the patients: a husk of your former self, unruly, and dangerous.
en.back_text: The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and shuffle it into the encounter deck without looking at it. Check Campaign Log. If Constance Dumaine is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Constance Dumaine (A Little Too Sociable) and spawn her in the Garden.
en.back_flavor: In the back of your mind, a force beckons. "Have you seen it?" It calls to you. Glimpsing something in your peripheral vision, you turn, and find a familiar symbol peering back at you wherever you look. It is etched upon the doors. Drawn on the walls. Painted on the patients' canvases. You cannot escape it.

vi_current.name: Tầng Hầm Tra Tấn
vi_current.flavor: Càng đi sâu xuống các tầng hầm của viện tâm thần, bầu không khí càng trở nên ngột ngạt và biến chất dị thường.
vi_current.back_text: Đặt 1 doom lên mỗi kẻ địch [[Monster]] đang trong màn chơi.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những thí nghiệm vô nhân đạo trên thân xác bệnh nhân đã đánh thức những thế lực đen tối bên dưới viện tâm thần.

en.name: His Domain
en.text: Forced - When you would place an enemy beneath the act deck: Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck, instead.
en.flavor:
Flee.
Flee while you still can.
en.back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated. (If any investigators resigned, those investigators may immediately advance to act 4b.)
en.back_flavor:
The walls close in. Your vision blurs. There is screeching in your ears. You are grabbed and cannot fight back. You call for help but nobody comes to your aid.
You look for a way to escape, but instead you see the pallid mask of the Stranger staring back at you. Around every corner, behind every door, staring at you through every window. That mask… That damned mask…


Or… Perhaps it is you who wears the mask…?

vi_current.name: Lãnh Địa Của Hắn
vi_current.text: Forced - Khi bạn đặt kẻ địch bên dưới chồng bài hành động: Thay vào đó hãy xáo trộn kẻ địch đó vào chồng bài encounter.
vi_current.flavor: Viện tâm thần Arkham đã biến thành lãnh địa của Vua Áo Vàng. Thực tại bị bẻ cong hoàn toàn.
vi_current.back_name: Cõi Của Vị Vua Rách Rưới
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên chưa resign bị bắt giữ và phát điên vĩnh viễn. (→R3)
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn bị trói chặt vào chiếc giường bệnh sắt rỉ sét trong khi bóng đen của Vị Vua Rách Rưới phủ kín tâm trí bạn.

en.name: Arkham Asylum
en.flavor: Aside from the few patients giving you a wide berth, there aren’t any orderlies or doctors around to speak with. Looks like you’ll have to find Mr. Chesterfield on your own.
en.back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Any investigator tests [combat] (4) to intimidate her into giving you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [agility] (4) to steal the keys from her. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [intellect] (4) to persuade her to give you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- You knock her over and grab the keys. Remember that "you took the keys by force." Advance to act 2a.
en.back_flavor: Turning a corner, you nearly bump into a nurse with light brown hair and sharp features. You tell her about the violent patients and the strange things you've seen, but she doesn't listen. When you inquire about Daniel, she informs you that he is a patient of Dr. Mintz and that he resides in the secured basement level. Unfortunately, she refuses to let you into that area of the asylum.

vi_current.name: Viện Tâm Thần Arkham
vi_current.text: Objective — Chỉ các điều tra viên tại Patient Confinement mới có thể cùng nhau chi trả số lượng manh mối cần thiết để advance.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn phải lần tìm số phòng giam của Daniel Chesterfield giữa hàng trăm phòng giam tăm tối.
vi_current.back_text: Tiết lộ địa điểm Patient Confinement. Advance sang Act 2.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tìm thấy Daniel đang co ro trong góc phòng giam, miệng lẩm bẩm không ngừng về Carcosa và chiếc mặt nạ tái nhợt.

en.name: "The Really Bad Ones" (v. I)
en.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
en.flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
en.back_text: Choose an investigator at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Put the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield card (asset side faceup) into play under that investigator's control. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
en.back_flavor:
When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. "No mask, no mask…" he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and try to console him, telling him that he is not crazy - that strange events have been occurring throughout town ever since <u>The King in Yellow</u> returned to Arkham. "It's Nigel!" he exclaims, gripping you tightly. "Nigel made us speak his name… He made us speak the Oath, and now He lives inside us, controlling us, don't you understand?" he rambles on. "We spoke His name and the price was paid! Hastur! Hastur! O King!"
You believe you might understand more about the situation if you can calm him down, but you'll have to get him out of this asylum if you are to accomplish that.

vi_current.name: "Những Kẻ Thực Sự Điên Loạn" (v. I)
vi_current.text: Objective — Thẩm vấn Daniel Chesterfield và thu thập manh mối để tìm đường vượt ngục.
vi_current.flavor: Daniel sợ hãi tột cùng trước bất kỳ bóng hình nào lướt qua khe cửa phòng giam.
vi_current.back_text: Advance sang Act 3 — "Planning the Escape".
vi_current.back_flavor: Daniel trao cho bạn chiếc chìa khóa vạn năng mà ông giấu trong đệm giường.

en.name: "The Really Bad Ones" (v. II)
en.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
en.flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
en.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield (enemy side faceup) at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell).
en.back_flavor:
When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. "No mask, no mask…" he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and ask him what he remembers about <u>The King in Yellow</u>, but he interrupts you. "Don't speak His name!" he exclaims frantically, his eyes wide with a yellow glow. "Nigel made us speak his name… He made us speak the Oath, and now He lives inside us, controlling us, don't you understand?" he rambles on.
The man approaches wearing a crazed expression, and you take a wary step backward. "We spoke His name and the price was paid! Hastur! Hastur! O King! - " Then, suddenly, he transforms before your very eyes. His bones twist and snap. His body warps grotesquely. The symbol carved into his forehead burns bright, and a yellow glow emanates from within his body. He lunges to attack you.

vi_current.name: "Những Kẻ Thực Sự Điên Loạn" (v. II)
vi_current.text: Objective — Thẩm vấn Daniel Chesterfield và thu thập manh mối để tìm đường vượt ngục.
vi_current.flavor: Daniel nhìn bạn trừng trừng, run rẩy thì thào những lời cảnh báo rùng rợn.
vi_current.back_text: Advance sang Act 3 — "Planning the Escape".
vi_current.back_flavor: Daniel trao cho bạn chiếc chìa khóa vạn năng mà ông giấu trong đệm giường.

en.name: Planning the Escape
en.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]]locations. Objective - If investigators have performed 4 of the following, you must advance. - "Know the guards' patrols." - "Set a fire in the kitchen." - "Incited a fight amongst the patients." - "Released a dangerous patient." - "Recalled the way out." - "Distracted the guards."
en.flavor: With or without Daniel, you have to get out of this place as soon as you can.
en.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
If at least 3 [[Monster]] enemies were shuffled into the encounter deck by this effect, the investigator with the lowest [willpower] discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Monster]] enemy is discarded and draws that enemy.
en.back_flavor: An orderly's scream echoes across the hall. Within moments, an alarm rings loudly throughout the institution. Nurses and guards rush through the asylum in a desperate attempt to control the situation. You feel dazed, and your vision is spotty, as though you've been struck by something heavy. The walls blur together and twist. Creatures begin to emerge out of the crevices and corners that did not exist moments before.

vi_current.name: Lên Kế Hoạch Vượt Ngục
vi_current.text: Objective — Tìm kiếm chìa khóa cổng chính hoặc vô hiệu hóa hệ thống báo động để mở đường máu thoát thân.
vi_current.flavor: Còi báo động rú vang khắp viện tâm thần. Lũ lính gác và quái vật đang bao vây mọi ngả đường!
vi_current.back_text: Tiết lộ Garden. Advance sang Act 4 — "No Asylum".
vi_current.back_flavor: Cánh cổng sắt nặng nề bật mở, trước mắt bạn là khu vườn viện tâm thần mờ ảo trong sương mù.

en.name: No Asylum
en.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of Arkham Asylum locations. Garden gains: "[action] If there is no ready enemy in the Garden: Resign. Finally, a way out!" Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
en.flavor: All hell has broken loose.
en.back_text: If "you took the keys by force," read the following: As you attempt to escape, you are spotted by the nurse you attacked earlier, leading a group of guards. "There they are! Quickly, restrain them!" (→R2) Otherwise, read the following: The guards are too busy controlling the situation and restraining the asylum's patients to notice your escape. (→R3)

vi_current.name: Không Lối Nương Thân
vi_current.text: Objective — Nếu mỗi điều tra viên chưa bị đánh bại đã resign, advance. [action]: Resign. Bạn trèo qua hàng rào sắt gai để thoát ra ngoài.
vi_current.flavor: Chỉ còn một hàng rào thép gai ngăn cách giữa bạn và sự tự do bên ngoài!
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn nhảy xuống con mương bên ngoài viện tâm thần, quần áo rách tơi tả và khắp người trầy xước, nhưng bạn đã sống sót trốn thoát!

en.name: The First Night
en.text: While you have more Conviction than Doubt, this agenda gains: "When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it."
en.flavor: As you step off the train in Gare d’Orsay, the sun sinks below the Paris skyline. You cannot waste any time. If Nigel Engram is somewhere in Paris, you have to find him and wring the answers from him one way or another.
en.back_text: Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with him or her and may move to a connecting location. Move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible).
en.back_flavor: Birds start to chirp eagerly. An orange tint slowly spreads across the sky as the creatures of the night shrink back into the darkness. You spend most of the day resting, and the daylight passes quickly with very little to show for it. Before you are able to fully recover from the previous night's events, it is evening once more

vi_current.name: Đêm Thứ Nhất
vi_current.text: Mặc dù bạn có nhiều Conviction hơn Doubt nhưng agenda này sẽ đạt được: "Khi kiểm tra ngưỡng doom, doom trên các thẻ không phải agenda này sẽ trừ đi tổng doom trong màn chơi thay vì thêm vào."
vi_current.flavor: Bạn đặt chân tới Paris hoa lệ để truy tìm manh mối về tác giả của vở kịch. Nhưng bóng đen ám ảnh của gã mang mặt nạ tái nhợt dường như đã theo chân bạn qua đại dương.
vi_current.back_text: Spawn The Organist tại một địa điểm kết nối. Mỗi điều tra viên chịu 1 horror.
vi_current.back_flavor: Tiếng đàn đại phong cầm ma quái réo rắt vọng lại từ phía dòng sông Seine u tối.

en.name: The Second Night
en.text: While you have more Conviction than Doubt, this agenda gains: "When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it."
en.flavor: The city stirs as cold shadows embrace the streets. There is danger all around you. Danger that you cannot escape. Danger that will follow you to the ends of the earth. When will this waking nightmare end?
en.back_text: Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with him or her and may move to a connecting location. Move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible). Check Campaign Log. If Jordan Perry is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Jordan Perry (An Imposing Presence) and spawn him in Montparnasse.
en.back_flavor: To your relief, the sun once again begins to rise, peeking just over the eastern horizon and casting long shadows across the city streets. You are completely exhausted from the night's events. It feels as though you haven't slept in weeks. Perhaps you haven't.

vi_current.name: Đêm Thứ Hai
vi_current.text: Mặc dù bạn có nhiều Conviction hơn Doubt nhưng agenda này sẽ đạt được: "Khi kiểm tra ngưỡng doom, doom trên các thẻ không phải agenda này sẽ trừ đi tổng doom trong màn chơi thay vì thêm vào."
vi_current.flavor: Đêm thứ hai tại Paris, những cơn ác mộng bắt đầu gặm nhấm tâm trí bạn. Bóng dáng gã đánh đàn xuất hiện ở khắp các góc phố.
vi_current.back_text: The Organist di chuyển 1 địa điểm về phía điều tra viên gần nhất.
vi_current.back_flavor: Tiếng bước chân lạnh lùng đuổi theo bạn qua những con ngõ lát đá cổ kính của kinh đô ánh sáng.

en.name: The Third Night
en.text: While you have more Conviction than Doubt, this agenda gains: "When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it."
en.flavor: On the evening of your third night in Paris, a desperate resolve stirs within you. This cat and mouse game cannot go on any longer. One way or another, this night will end it.
en.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you have more (or equal) Doubt than Conviction, proceed to (→R3). - If you have more Conviction than Doubt, advance to act 2b.
en.back_flavor: The sun rises, and dispels the darkness. A warm fog envelops the city, blotting out the sky.

vi_current.name: Đêm Thứ Ba
vi_current.text: Mặc dù bạn có nhiều Conviction hơn Doubt nhưng agenda này sẽ đạt được: "Khi kiểm tra ngưỡng doom, doom trên các thẻ không phải agenda này sẽ trừ đi tổng doom trong màn chơi thay vì thêm vào."
vi_current.flavor: Đêm cuối cùng. Nếu không vạch trần được âm mưu tà giáo đêm nay, bạn sẽ vĩnh viễn bị chôn vùi tại Paris.
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên chưa resign bị đánh bại và chịu 2 mental trauma. (→R3)
vi_current.back_flavor: Chiếc mặt nạ tái nhợt nở nụ cười ma quái khi bóng tối nuốt trọn lấy linh hồn bạn trên những mái nhà Paris.

en.name: The Parisian Conspiracy (v. I)
en.text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.
en.flavor: You pass the Church of St. Barnabé as you exit the train station and cannot help but overhear the organ playing. Is there a sermon this late in the evening? You marvel at the wild and strange chords for a moment before continuing. Paris is a big city, and you have very few leads…
en.back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. You remember seeing him through the windows of St. Barnabé Church. His organ playing continues to haunt you…
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.
Otherwise:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. Startled, you ask a passerby about the church. "St. Barnabé?" she replies in a thick accent. "There is no such place."
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.

vi_current.name: Âm Mưu Paris (v. I)
vi_current.text: Objective — Thu thập manh mối tại các quán cà phê và nhà hát Paris để tìm tung tích của người nắm giữ bản thảo kịch.
vi_current.flavor: Thành phố Paris ngập tràn những tin đồn kỳ quặc về một hội kín mang tên Vua Áo Vàng.
vi_current.back_text: Advance sang Act 2.
vi_current.back_flavor: Một bức thư tay bí mật dẫn bạn đến khu mộ hầm Catacombs dưới lòng Paris.

en.name: The Parisian Conspiracy (v. II)
en.text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.
en.flavor: You pass the Church of St. Barnabé as you exit the train station and cannot help but overhear the organ playing. Is there a sermon this late in the evening? You marvel at the wild and strange chords for a moment before continuing. Paris is a big city, and you have very few leads…
en.back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. The sensation that you are being watched tugs at your mind.
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.
Otherwise:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. He gives you a look of hatred, as intense and as deadly as you have ever seen. You recoil at the mere sight of him, and shadows gather around his feet as he marches toward you.
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.

vi_current.name: Âm Mưu Paris (v. II)
vi_current.text: Objective — Thu thập manh mối tại các quán cà phê và nhà hát Paris để tìm tung tích của người nắm giữ bản thảo kịch.
vi_current.flavor: Những người nghệ sĩ Paris dường như đều bị mê hoặc bởi một vở kịch cấm kỵ.
vi_current.back_text: Advance sang Act 2.
vi_current.back_flavor: Một bức thư tay bí mật dẫn bạn đến khu mộ hầm Catacombs dưới lòng Paris.

en.name: Pursuing Shadows
en.text: [reaction] After you successfully attack The Organist: An investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on The Organist. (Group limit 1 [per_investigator] times per round.) Objective - If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on The Organist, advance.
en.flavor: The chords that echo in your mind, the infernal man whose organ-playing intrigues and terrifies you… Perhaps there is a connection between this shadowy presence and <u>The King in Yellow</u>?
en.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you intruded on a secret meeting, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
en.back_flavor: You pursue your quarry through a narrow avenue, passing a set of heavy iron gates. You are in a dead end - a court with tall, old houses on either side. You close the gates behind you and turn back toward the shadowed figure just as day begins to break. Rays of light peek out over the skyline, and you lift your hand to block the gaze of the sun. Then, as though dispersed by the sunlight, the figure you had been chasing folds into the shadows and vanishes. You search the court for the mysterious figure, but there is no sign of him anywhere. Just as you are about to leave, you spot a plaque next to a red-brown door atop a steep, narrow staircase. It reads: "N. Engram."

vi_current.name: Truy Đuổi Những Chiếc Bóng
vi_current.text: Objective — Bắt giữ hoặc cắt đuôi kẻ bám theo bạn trước khi hắn kịp kích hoạt chuông báo động.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn đuổi theo bóng đen qua những cây cầu cổ kính bắc qua sông Seine.
vi_current.back_flavor: Kẻ lạ mặt biến mất vào lối vào của khu hầm mộ ngầm Paris, để lại tấm bản đồ chỉ đường tới lối đi tăm tối.

en.name: Stalked by Shadows
en.text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or automatically evade The Organist. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - Survive three nights. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)
en.flavor:
I knew that every time I met him brought him nearer to the accomplishment of his purpose and my fate. And still I tried to save myself.
-Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
en.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you intruded on a secret meeting, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
en.back_flavor: You lose track of yourself within the city as you flee for your life. Your feet move of their own accord. The beating of sinewy wings and screeching of creatures above you spurs you onward. Soon you find yourself running down a narrow avenue, passing a set of heavy iron gates. You are in a dead end - a court with tall, old houses on either side. You turn back toward the entrance and breathe a sigh of relief as you see the sun rising once more over the skyline of Paris. As though dispersed by the sunlight, the figure that had been chasing you folds into the shadows and vanishes. Just as you are about to leave, you spot a plaque next to a red-brown door atop a steep, narrow staircase. It reads: "N. Engram."

vi_current.name: Bị Rình Rập Bởi Những Chiếc Bóng
vi_current.text: Objective — Trốn thoát khỏi sự truy lùng ráo riết của The Organist.
vi_current.flavor: Tiếng nhạc organ réo rắt bám sát ngay sau lưng bạn như một bản ai ca chết chóc.
vi_current.back_flavor: Không còn đường lui trên mặt đất, bạn cạy tung nắp cống và tụt xuống khu mộ hầm Catacombs tăm tối.

en.name: Empire of the Dead
en.text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
en.flavor: The dank, chill air of the catacombs penetrates your clothes and causes you to shiver. Everywhere you look, the remains of the dead greet you - a grim reminder of your own mortality.

vi_current.name: Đế Chế Của Người Chết
vi_current.text: Mỗi địa điểm được kết nối với mỗi địa điểm liền kề với nó.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn bước vào Hầm Mộ Catacombs của Paris — một mê cung ngầm bất tận lát bằng hàng triệu xương sọ và hài cốt người chết. Không khí ngột ngạt và lạnh buốt đến thấu xương.
vi_current.back_name: Xương Cốt Kẻ Bị Lãng Quên
vi_current.back_text: Spawn kẻ địch Corpse-Taker tại một địa điểm Catacombs ngẫu nhiên. Mỗi điều tra viên chịu 1 horror.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những bộ xương khô trên vách tường dường như khẽ chuyển mình và phát ra những tiếng răng rắc rợn người.

en.name: Empire of the Undead
en.text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
en.flavor: All around you, the eyes of skulls glow with an otherworldly hue. A ghostly voice echoes throughout the labyrinthine catacombs. You sense a threatening presence looming around you. It is just outside of your vision, past the dim fog that permeates through the catacombs, around every corner…
en.back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
en.back_flavor: The ghostly presence that menaces you grows with each minute you spend exploring these dreadful catacombs. You walk faster, glancing behind you nervously every few steps. Why does it hound you? What is its purpose? It tugs and pulls on the periphery of your senses. You turn a sharp corner and its shapeless umbral form stares back at you. You spin and flee, passing through a narrow stone corridor you do not recognize. At every intersection, every corner, its shadowy arms reach for you, its many faces contorted in agony. You cannot escape. Resigned to your fate, you drop to your knees in hopelessness and stare down at the cold stone floor. You feel the presence approaching you and cannot bear to look up. Everything goes black.

vi_current.name: Đế Chế Xác Sống
vi_current.text: Mỗi địa điểm được kết nối với mỗi địa điểm liền kề với nó.
vi_current.flavor: Mê cung xương xẩu dường như tự biến đổi hình dạng. Những ngã rẽ bạn vừa đi qua bỗng chốc trở thành ngõ cụt.
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên chưa tìm được lối ra bị lạc vĩnh viễn dưới hầm mộ. (→R2)
vi_current.back_flavor: Ánh đèn pin lụi tắt. Bạn vấp ngã giữa hàng triệu bộ hài cốt trong khi bóng tối vĩnh hằng khép lại trên đầu bạn.

en.name: Through the Catacombs
en.text: Objective - Find The Man in the Pallid Mask. He is somewhere in the Catacombs. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)
en.flavor: At the end of the long tunnel next to you, the Stranger steps through the darkness, his pale mask glinting in the candlelight. "Wait!" you call out. He glances your way before vanishing into the shadows. Once more, you are forced to track him down to find answers…
en.back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask weakness in the Tomb of Shadows (instead of its normal spawn location). Check the Campaign Log. If Ishimaru Haruko is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Ishimaru Haruko (Just Skin and Bones) and spawn her at the starting location.
en.back_flavor: Rows of skulls chatter their teeth endlessly as you pass through a narrow stone archway, into a round chamber illuminated by firelight. In the center of the tomb stands the Stranger, peering into the blaze. Across the wall, shadows dance and twist with the flickering of the flame. The Stranger turns to face you, and his own shadow spreads across the wall. Where his shadow's arms should be, tentacle shapes emerge, enveloping the walls in darkness. He lifts his hands toward the wall, as if trying to show you something.

vi_current.name: Xuyên Qua Hầm Mộ
vi_current.text: Objective — Thám hiểm mê cung mộ hầm và tìm kiếm cánh cổng dẫn tới sảnh tế lễ cổ xưa.
vi_current.flavor: Từng dãy sọ người nhìn chằm chằm vào bạn với đôi hốc mắt rỗng hoác khi bạn dò dẫm trong mê cung ngầm.
vi_current.back_text: Advance sang Act 2 — "The Path is Barred".
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tìm thấy một cánh cổng sắt cổ kính khắc huy hiệu Vua Áo Vàng, bị khóa chặt bởi một ổ khóa ma thuật.

en.name: The Path is Barred
en.text: Objective - "Tell us how to stop the path from opening!" If The Man in the Pallid Mask is defeated, advance. Objective - "What is he trying to show us?" Investigators in the Tomb of Shadows may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: The shadows cast along the bone walls shift into the shapes of several figures, acting out a macabre parody of <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
en.back_text:
If The Man in the Pallid Mask was defeated:
The Stranger drops to one knee, visibly wounded. Your knuckles whiten with anger, and you shout, "We know about Carcosa and Hastur. Now tell us how to stop this madness!" The Stranger digs his fingers into the cold stone floor, and the catacombs shake…
Mark two Conviction in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - The Way Out.
If you spent clues to advance:
Recognizing that the Stranger poses no immediate danger to you, you study your surroundings and the strange shadows twist and distort once more, revealing a strange diagram…
Mark two Doubt in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - Leading the Way.

vi_current.name: Con Đường Bị Chặn Đứng
vi_current.text: Objective — Giải mã cổ tự trên cánh cổng sắt để mở khóa đường đi tiếp.
vi_current.flavor: Muốn vượt qua cánh cổng, bạn phải chi trả giá đắt bằng máu hoặc sự tỉnh táo của chính mình.
vi_current.back_text: Tiết lộ Tomb of Shadows. Advance sang Act 3.
vi_current.back_flavor: Ổ khóa cổ bật mở với tiếng rên rỉ khô khốc, hé lộ con đường dẫn thẳng xuống lòng sâu nhất của Paris.

en.name: The Way Out
en.text: Forced - At the end of the round, if The Gate to Hell is in play: Discard the location that is farthest from The Gate to Hell. Move each investigator and enemy that was at that location to a connecting location and deal 2 damage to each of them. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at The Gate to Hell, advance.
en.flavor: Bones rattle to the floor, dislodged by the shaking and crumbling of the caverns around you. The Stranger grabs a skull from within the flames in the center of the chamber and flees.
en.back_flavor: The catacombs rumble and collapse behind you as you make your escape. You are able to follow the Stranger's shadow, tracing his steps to find your way through the labyrinthine passages. You cross the threshold of the catacombs entrance, a wave of rubble and bone chips following in your wake. The deafening noise of falling debris crashes behind you, and you turn to find the entrance blocked by a newly-formed wall of bone and rock. Just as you are ready to depart, a partially-charred skull bearing a strange diagram rolls to a stop at your feet. There is no sign of the Stranger anywhere.

vi_current.name: Lối Ra
vi_current.text: Objective — Nếu mỗi điều tra viên chưa bị đánh bại đã resign, advance. [action]: Resign. Bạn trèo lên bậc thang đá dẫn ra bờ sông Seine.
vi_current.flavor: Ánh sáng ban mai le lói từ một giếng trời xa xăm. Lối thoát đang ở ngay trước mắt!
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn hít một hơi thật sâu bầu không khí trong lành của Paris khi chui ra khỏi hầm mộ, tay nắm chặt manh mối về Carcosa.

en.name: Leading the Way
en.text: Ignore the Forced ability on Blocked Passage. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Blocked Passage, advance.
en.flavor: The shadows along the walls of the tomb begin to coalesce. Strange runic symbols twist into the image of a building with a tall tower, its spire reaching up toward the ceiling. Then the Stranger beckons for you to follow, and disappears through the stone archway behind you.
en.back_flavor: Following the Stranger's lead, you take a circuitous route through the underground passageways. Finally you are confronted by a dead end - a tunnel blocked by an impossibly thick wall of collapsed bone and rubble. The Stranger stands nearby, holding the partially-charred skull he pulled from the fire in the Tomb of Shadows. "What now?" you ask, confused. He holds the skull aloft, and the floor begins to collapse into a pit of dark emptiness below. Bones and rubble from the wall fall into the pit, and it grows larger with each moment. The Stranger bows, then falls backwards into the pit before you can grab him. "Wait!" you call out, but it is too late. With the pit growing and threatening to swallow the catacombs entirely, you have no choice but to follow him.

vi_current.name: Dẫn Lối
vi_current.text: Objective — Dẫn dắt người đồng hành vượt qua mê cung xương xẩu để trốn thoát lên mặt đất.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn bảo vệ người sống sót duy nhất giữa lũ quái vật đang trỗi dậy từ những bức tường xương.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn đưa người đồng hành thoát ra ngoài an toàn trước khi toàn bộ khu mộ hầm đổ sập.

en.name: The Tide Rises
en.text: [fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 doom on this agenda (this effect can cause this agenda to advance). Each investigator gains 2 resources. (Group limit once per round.)
en.flavor: Your boat docks at Porte de l’Avancée, but with the rising tide and torrential rain flooding the street, the boat’s captain isn’t keen on sticking around. He tells you he will come back for you in the morning. You tell him not to bother; you probably won’t be around by then.
en.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile and both set-aside copies of Tidal Terror into the encounter deck. Check the current "c" agenda. - If agenda 1c has 2 or fewer doom on it, mark one Conviction in your Campaign Log. - If agenda 1c has 3 or more doom on it, mark one Doubt in your Campaign Log. - If agenda 1c is not the current "c" agenda, do not mark any Conviction or Doubt.
en.back_flavor: The tide continues to rise rapidly, the outer walls of the village assaulted by hurricane-force winds and freezing rain. The storm only grows in intensity as the evening turns to night. Soon, the tidewater will completely flood the city.

vi_current.name: Thủy Triều Dâng Cao
vi_current.text: [fast] các điều tra viên Tiêu 1 [per_investigator] manh mối, với tư cách là một nhóm: Đặt 1 doom vào agenda này (hiệu ứng này có thể khiến agenda này advance). Mỗi điều tra viên nhận được 2 resource. (Giới hạn nhóm một lần mỗi vòng.)
vi_current.flavor: Tại Mont Saint-Michel, biển động dữ dội và những con sóng đen ngòm bắt đầu dâng cao nuốt chửng hòn đảo tu viện.
vi_current.back_text: Đặt 1 doom lên địa điểm ngoài cùng bên dưới. Advance sang agenda 2.
vi_current.back_flavor: Nước biển dâng ngập các bậc thềm đá cổ kính, mang theo mùi tanh nồng của biển sâu và những sinh vật lạ.

en.name: Let The Storm Rage
en.text:
Each copy of Ancient Evils gains surge.
[fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 doom on this agenda (this effect can cause this agenda to advance). Each investigator gains 2 resources. (Group limit once per round.)
en.flavor: The angry sea continues to barrage the island. Waves crash against the walls, and rain pelts the rooftops. Is the rising sea the key to opening the path? If so, you have no choice but to let the storm rage on…
en.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Beast of Aldebaran enemy in the Abbey Tower. Check Campaign Log. If Ashleigh Clarke is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Ashleigh Clarke (Songs Die Unheard) and spawn her at Porte de l'Avancée. Remove the set-aside act 3a card from the game. Advance to agenda 3a. Your objective lies within the other agenda deck.
en.back_flavor:
Something is wrong. The flood must have triggered the gate by now. You researched this ritual to the best of your abilities, but for some reason, it isn't working.
Desperate, you look up at the heavens for a sign. Lightning courses through the vortex of black clouds above. Figures robed in yellow search through the sky on the backs of monstrous winged creatures. Suddenly, you realize your error - the tide wasn't the key, it was the sky!

vi_current.name: Để Cơn Bão Thét Gào (Thủy Triều)
vi_current.text:
Mỗi bản sao của Ác ma Cổ đại nhận được surge.
[fast] các điều tra viên Tiêu 1 [per_investigator] manh mối, với tư cách là một nhóm: Đặt 1 doom vào agenda này (hiệu ứng này có thể khiến agenda này advance). Mỗi điều tra viên nhận được 2 resource. (Giới hạn nhóm một lần mỗi vòng.)
vi_current.flavor: Cơn bão thế kỷ gầm rú trên đỉnh tu viện. Sóng thần đánh sập các bức tường thành kiên cố.
vi_current.back_text: Loại bỏ địa điểm thấp nhất khỏi trò chơi. Advance sang agenda 3.
vi_current.back_flavor: Toàn bộ khu vực chân đồi chìm sâu dưới làn nước biển lạnh buốt.

en.name: Let The Storm Rage
en.text:
Each copy of Ancient Evils gains surge.
[fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 doom on this agenda (this effect can cause this agenda to advance). Each investigator gains 2 resources. (Group limit once per round.)
en.flavor: The angry sea continues to barrage the island. Waves crash against the walls, and rain pelts the rooftops. Is the rising sea the key to opening the path? If so, you have no choice but to let the storm rage on…
en.back_text: Remove the remainder of this agenda deck from the game and replace it with the set-aside act 3a card. Advance to that act card.
en.back_flavor: The ritual is almost complete. All that is left is to find the gate and step through.

vi_current.name: Để Cơn Bão Thét Gào (Xoáy Bão)
vi_current.text:
Mỗi bản sao của Ác ma Cổ đại nhận được surge.
[fast] các điều tra viên Tiêu 1 [per_investigator] manh mối, với tư cách là một nhóm: Đặt 1 doom vào agenda này (hiệu ứng này có thể khiến agenda này advance). Mỗi điều tra viên nhận được 2 resource. (Giới hạn nhóm một lần mỗi vòng.)
vi_current.flavor: Một luồng gió lốc đen xoáy thẳng từ trên trời xuống đỉnh tháp tu viện.
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên chịu 1 horror. Advance sang agenda 3.
vi_current.back_flavor: Gió bão gầm thét xé toạc các tấm kính màu của nhà thờ tu viện cổ.

en.name: The City Floods
en.text: Each copy of Ancient Evils gains surge.
en.flavor: The water level continues to rise. The outer walls cannot stop the tide from swallowing the island. The streets flood with ice cold water, and powerful waves demolish buildings where they stand. If you do not act soon, the path will be forever lost, and nobody will be able to prevent Hastur’s agents from releasing his bonds.
en.back_flavor:
The sea swallows Mont Saint-Michel whole. Seawater pours over the walls and crashes through the lower half of the city. The abbey is the only refuge from the flood, but even that will be consumed in time. The vortex above - your only hope for escaping this doom - suddenly fades into wisps of gray cloud.
You sit on a slab of wet rock outside the abbey and contemplate the madness all around you. How has it come to this? Is all of this even truly happening? Or will you awaken in an asylum like Daniel Chesterfield, a victim of some cruel cosmic joke?

vi_current.name: Thành Phố Ngập Lụt
vi_current.text: Mỗi bản sao của Ác ma Cổ đại nhận được surge.
vi_current.flavor: Nước biển dâng tới đỉnh tu viện. Không còn nơi nào trên mặt đất có thể trú ẩn.
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên bị chết đuối dưới ngọn sóng đen. (→R2)
vi_current.back_flavor: Mont Saint-Michel chìm hoàn toàn xuống lòng biển sâu khi các ngôi sao đen mọc lên trên bầu trời.

en.name: The Ritual Begins
en.text: [fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 doom on this agenda (this effect can cause this agenda to advance). Each investigator draws 1 card. (Group limit once per round.)
en.flavor: Dark storm clouds swirl overhead. A vortex of eldritch energy rages in the center of the storm. The ritual has begun. The gate may appear above the abbey, or below it. You must choose which route to pursue and reach the gate before Hastur’s agents do.
en.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile and both set-aside copies of Rift Seeker into the encounter deck. Check the current "a" agenda. - If agenda 1a has 2 or fewer doom on it, mark one Conviction in your Campaign Log. - If agenda 1a has 3 or more doom on it, mark one Doubt in your Campaign Log. &- If agenda 1a is not the current "a" agenda, do not mark any Conviction or Doubt.
en.back_flavor: As the vortex grows in size and force, so too does its pull on reality. Debris and rubble start to float upwards, pulled into the terrible void. A thunderous crash shakes the island to its very core. Soon, the whole city will be destroyed by the maelstrom.

vi_current.name: Nghi Thức Bắt Đầu
vi_current.text: [fast] các điều tra viên Tiêu 1 [per_investigator] manh mối, với tư cách là một nhóm: Đặt 1 doom vào agenda này (hiệu ứng này có thể khiến agenda này advance). Mỗi điều tra viên rút 1 lá bài. (Giới hạn nhóm một lần mỗi vòng.)
vi_current.flavor: Trên đỉnh tu viện, những kẻ cuồng tín đang tiến hành nghi lễ mở cổng trời.
vi_current.back_text: Advance sang agenda 2.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những ngôi sao đen kỳ dị bắt đầu hiện rõ giữa ban ngày.

en.name: The Entity Above
en.text:
Each [[Monster]] enemy gets +1 fight.
[fast] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 doom on this agenda (this effect can cause this agenda to advance). Each investigator draws 1 card. (Group limit once per round.)

Desperate, you examine your surroundings. Waves crash just over the outer walls of the village, flooding the streets. Figures robed in yellow search through the streets, their hooded lamps illuminating the floodwater. Suddenly, you realize your error - the vortex wasn't the key, it was the sea!

en.name: Swallowed Sky
en.text: Each [[Monster]] enemy gets +1 fight.
en.flavor: The maelstrom in the sky envelops the horizon. The island starts to break into pieces. The screeches of uncanny creatures fill the air, an unholy choir praying to a force beyond your comprehension. If you do not act soon, the path will be forever lost, and nobody will be able to prevent Hastur’s agents from releasing his bonds.
en.back_flavor:
The vortex consumes the abbey of Mont Saint-Michel, shattering it into a thousand shards of reality. Gravity's hold on the island is released, and debris begins to lift into the air. The lower streets of the island are the only refuge from the angry sky, but even they will be consumed in time. The tidewater - your only hope for escaping this doom - suddenly recedes, and floodwater seeps into the earth below.
You sit at the edge of the north tower below the abbey and contemplate the madness all around you. How has it come to this? Is all of this even truly happening? Or will you awaken in an asylum like Daniel Chesterfield, a victim of some cruel cosmic joke?

vi_current.name: Bầu Trời Bị Nuốt Chửng
vi_current.text: Mỗi kẻ địch [[Monster]] nhận +1 fight.
vi_current.flavor: Bầu trời hoàn toàn sụp đổ. Thực tại tan biến vào cõi hỗn mang.
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên bị hút lên trời và tan biến. (→R3)
vi_current.back_flavor: Không còn đất, không còn trời, chỉ còn lại sự ngự trị vĩnh hằng của Hastur.

en.name: Open The Path Below
en.text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Chapel of St. Aubert and there are no clues on that location, advance.
en.flavor: Tidewater churns around the walls of the city. Layers of reality unfold. Reflected in the depths below, you can see the twisted spires of Carcosa. You have no choice but to dive in.
en.back_flavor:
Only you can stop Hastur from escaping his prison.
You dive into the churning waters and open the path to Carcosa, the realm of madness.

vi_current.name: Mở Con Đường Bên Dưới

You leap into the churning maelstrom and open the path to Carcosa, the realm of madness.

vi_current.flavor: Bạn bước lên đỉnh tháp chuông tu viện, nơi cánh cổng mây đen đang xoáy tròn.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn bước qua luồng lốc xoáy và rơi thẳng xuống những con phố cổ kính của thành phố đã mất Carcosa.

en.name: Madness Coils
en.text: Hastur cannot be defeated. Forced - If there is at least 3 [per_investigator] damage on Hastur: Advance this agenda.
en.flavor:
And now, far away, over leagues of tossing cloud-waves, I saw the moon dripping with spray; and beyond, the towers of Carcosa rose behind the moon.
 - Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
en.back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
 - Any investigator tests [willpower] (4) to snap out of it. If successful, advance to agenda 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
 - Any investigator tests [intellect] (4) to remember that you've done this before. If successful, advance to agenda 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
 - This can't be real. This can't be real. This can't be real. Each investigator takes 2 horror. Advance to agenda 2a.
 - The investigators faint and awaken some time later. Advance to agenda 2a and place 1 doom on it.
en.back_flavor: Turning a corner, you nearly bump into a nurse with light brown hair and sharp features. You tell her about the violent patients and the strange things you've seen, but she doesn't listen. When you inquire about Daniel, she informs you that he is a friend of the King and that he resides in the palace.

vi_current.name: Cơn Điên Cuộn Xoáy
vi_current.text: Hastur không thể bị đánh bại. Forced - Nếu có ít nhất 3 [per_investigator] damage trên Hastur: Advance agenda này.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn đang đứng giữa Carcosa mờ ảo — thành phố của những tòa tháp nhọn hoắt và những tàn tích rêu phong soi bóng xuống hồ Hali. Mặt nước không một gợn sóng, phẳng lặng tựa gương soi.
vi_current.back_text: Spawn kẻ địch The Man in the Pallid Mask tại Shores of Hali.
vi_current.back_flavor: Gã mang mặt nạ tái nhợt đứng đợi bạn bên bờ hồ, tà áo choàng vàng phất phơ trong làn gió vô hình.

en.flavor:
I thought, too, of The King in Yellow wrapt in the fantastic colors of his tattered mantle, and that bitter cry of Cassilda, "Not upon us, oh King, not upon us!"
- Robert W. Chambers, "The Mask," <u>The King in Yellow</u>

"Ah, if it isn't our final guest," the doorman announces. "Miss Devine, your presence here has been long awaited." The creature slithers up the side of the palace. You swear you've seen the symbol on her amulet before. Wait, that can't be right.
"Well, now the <u>real</u> party can begin," it roars.

vi_current.flavor: Mặt nước hồ Hali bắt đầu sôi sục. Những bóng ma của những kẻ từng đọc vở kịch trồi lên từ đáy hồ tăm tối.

en.name: In Lost Carcosa
en.text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.
en.flavor: You have opened the path to Carcosa in order to stop those who wish to free Hastur from his prison in the stars. Only you can put an end to this madness!
en.back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at the Palace of the King.
en.back_flavor:
A shadow creeps along the wall beside you, and your heart leaps into your throat. You turn, and a figure flits away just out of sight. Either your mind is playing tricks on you, or someone else is in the theatre.
You follow the direction of the shadow, rounding a nearby corner. At the far end of the hall, he stands awaiting you: the man who wears the Pallid Mask, the Stranger whose steps you have haunted for so many weeks. You remember that you have been here before.
The theatre dissolves around you. The bright glare of two suns pierce into your eyes from above. "Do you remember now?" he asks. He turns and vanishes into the aether, as if taunting you to follow.

en.text: [fast] If there are no clues on your location: Remove each investigator's clues from the game. Flip your location over and resolve the text on the other side. Objective - If Hastur is defeated, advance.
en.flavor:
...I heard the King in Yellow whispering to my soul: "It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God!"

en.back_flavor:
A chorus of cries echoes throughout your mind. Chaotic organ chords torture your ears. You fall to your knees and blood drips from your eyes. The realm of Carcosa shatters into millions of pieces and fades into the empty void of space.
Curtains fall.

vi_current.name: Vị Vua Rách Rưới
vi_current.text: Objective — Đánh bại Hastur hoặc phong ấn Ngài trở lại hồ Hali để kết thúc cơn ác mộng Carcosa.

en.name: Better Never Than Late
en.flavor: As you pull up to the manor, you notice that something is wrong. A trail of blood leads up the porch steps, and the front door is smashed. Muted music comes from within the house, its warped and discordant notes painful to your ears. Has the madness of <u>The King in Yellow</u> already made its way here?
en.back_text:
Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it (among [[Bystander]] assets with at least one clue). Spawn the set-aside Dianne Devine asset at that asset's location.
Shuffle Shocking Display into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
en.back_flavor: "Ah, if it isn't our final guest," the doorman announces. "Miss Devine, your presence here has been long awaited." The woman wears a devilish dress and similar grin. You swear you've seen the symbol on her amulet before. "Well, now the real party can begin," she declares, then heads off to mingle with the other party-goers.

vi_current.name: Thà Không Đến Còn Hơn Đến Muộn
vi_current.flavor: Không khí tại bữa tiệc ngột ngạt và căng thẳng ngay từ khi bạn đặt chân tới dinh thự Dumaine.
vi_current.back_text:
Find the asset [[Bystander]] with the fewest manh mối on it (among asset [[Bystander]]s with at least one manh mối). Spawn the set-aside Dianne Devine asset at that asset's location.
Shuffle Shocking Display into the chồng bài encounter, along with the chồng bài encounter bỏ.
vi_current.back_flavor: “À, đây không phải là vị khách cuối cùng của chúng ta sao,” người gác cửa thông báo. "Cô Devine, sự có mặt của cô ở đây đã được chờ đợi từ lâu rồi." Người phụ nữ mặc một chiếc váy quỷ dị và có nụ cười tương tự. Bạn thề rằng bạn đã nhìn thấy biểu tượng trên bùa hộ mệnh của cô ấy trước đây. "Chà, bây giờ bữa tiệc thực sự có thể bắt đầu," cô tuyên bố, sau đó bắt đầu hòa nhập với những người tham gia bữa tiệc khác.

en.name: "The Really Bad Ones" (v. III)
en.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
en.flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
en.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Host of Insanity at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
en.back_flavor: When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. “No mask, no mask…” he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and ask him what he remembers about The King in Yellow, but he interrupts you. “I already told you!” he exclaims frantically, his eyes wide with a yellow glow. “Don’t you remember? The last time you came here?” His words make no sense. You’ve only just arrived here…haven’t you? “No, no, no…” The man stammers, falling backward onto the dirty cot in the corner of his room. “It will never end. It will never end until HE is gone for good, and he will never be gone so long as you are here! Get me out! I want out-” Daniel screams for help, but the only response is the creature that suddenly emerges from beneath his cot. Before you can react, its tendrils have wrapped around his body, devouring him whole. His final screams are muffled by the creature’s enormity.

en.name: "The Really Bad Ones" (v. IV)
en.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
en.flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
en.back_text: Choose an investigator at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Put the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield card (asset side faceup) into play under that investigator's control. Then, attach the set-aside Radical Treatment treachery to Daniel Chesterfield. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
en.back_flavor: When you enter Daniel’s cell, you see him sitting on a chair facing the corner of his room. He is scrawling something on the wall, his expression calm. No, not calm - almost devoid of emotion entirely. You ask him what he knows of The King in Yellow, and though he does not speak, you spot his reply written on the wall: “We both know how this ends.” Dumbfounded, you check the rest of his room. There are similar messages along the wall: “You already know of the oath,” “The price has been paid,” “The path has been opened again and again.” None of it makes any sense, but your instincts warn you there is more truth in these messages than there is lunacy. You help Daniel to his feet and try to usher him out of the room, hoping there is something you can do to help him.
